title: Privacy Shadow: Measuring Node Predictability and Privacy Over Time
reasoning: The paper's central theme is privacy, an ethical concern. It proposes a novel method, the 'privacy shadow,' to measure how long a user's data remains predictable after they have requested its removal from a network. This directly quantifies a specific privacy risk and is framed in the context of data protection regulations like GDPR, making it a work focused on evaluating an ethical principle.
